record_title: Global pairwise incidence rigidity for transitive hypersurface families
limitations: The theorem controls pairwise intersections only; it does not fix triple or higher intersection topology and does not globally conjugate the family to the linear projective model. It is restricted to unoriented transitive families of closed embedded hypersurfaces in ambient dimension at least three. The motivating preprint is very recent, so differently phrased or unindexed parallel work remains a residual originality risk.
